author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Name: Conglomerate
Gamemode: NebulaDTM
Builders: A LOT Of People(Zedther, MerlinMaster, ScriptingCookies, ParaSpider, UltraBubbles618, Me <3)
3 Monuments

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/4Fszi
Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/02u6id7lkd7hnr6/ParaTeamwork.rar?dl=0
YAML:

This was built because of the lack of maps focusing on Teamwork in the past month. For this map you need to work as a team to push into each "hive" or "box" and claim it to push up and attack the enemies and destroy their monuments.
Each Box is connected with a "railroad" and each box has a different biome.
